method.name: SetHostedSyscalls
method.brief: Route every syscall this thread issues to its fault handler.
method.description: Puts the target TCB into hosted-syscall mode: from then on each syscall the thread executes is delivered as a seL4_Fault_UnknownSyscall to its fault handler instead of being dispatched as a native seL4 syscall. Used by hosted Windows processes.

method.name: ReadDebugState
method.brief: Read compact scheduler and IPC state for a target TCB.
method.description: Returns bounded kernel scheduler and IPC fields for the target TCB, plus the bound TCB of an optional Reply cap. This diagnostic extension does not affect scheduling policy.

param.name: reply
param.description: Optional Reply cap to inspect; 0 skips reply-object state.

param.name: schedulable
param.description: 1 when runnable with a bound scheduling context.

param.name: enqueued
param.description: 1 when linked into a ready queue.

method.name: ReadRuntime
method.brief: Read cumulative bound and donated execution time for a scheduling context.
method.description: The bound counter measures execution by the scheduling context's bound TCB. The donated counter measures execution by another TCB while carrying this scheduling context through IPC donation. Both counters are monotonic for the scheduling context's lifetime.

param.name: bound
param.description: Cumulative execution by the bound TCB.

param.name: donated
param.description: Cumulative execution while donated to another TCB.

method.name: ReadLegacyContext
method.brief: Atomically snapshot x86-64 public registers and legacy FXSAVE64 state.
method.description: Exact zero-word request, no extra caps. Returns 90 words: 20 public UserContext words with canonical continuation RIP, 64 FXSAVE64 words, then DR0, DR1, DR2, DR3, DR6, DR7. Requires a writable retained IPC Frame. Self-target and other architectures are rejected. Does not suspend or resume the target.

method.name: WriteLegacyContext
method.brief: Atomically install x86-64 public registers and legacy FXSAVE64 state.
method.description: Exact 91-word request, no extra caps: selection mask, 20 public UserContext words, 64 FXSAVE64 words, then DR0, DR1, DR2, DR3, DR6, DR7. Mask bits 0 through 17 select the corresponding public register, bit 20 selects the complete FXSAVE64 state, bit 21 requests restart after installation, and bit 22 selects all six debug registers; all other bits are rejected. Requires a readable retained IPC Frame. Selected invalid MXCSR or debug state, self-target and other architectures are rejected before target mutation. Unselected fields, counted single-stepping policy and separately configured TLS bases remain unchanged. Without restart, scheduling state is unchanged. Restart atomically cancels outstanding IPC and reply waits, clears pending fault state, and makes the target runnable, matching WriteRegisters restart semantics. Consuming a pending debug fault acknowledges cached DR6 unless explicit debug state is selected; no other unselected debug register changes.

method.name: AcquireExecutionHold
method.brief: Exclude target execution without changing its underlying wait or context.
method.description: Exact zero-word request without extra caps. Stalls the target under the kernel lock, withdraws execution admission, and returns one nonzero globally unique generation word. An existing hold or generation exhaustion rejects before effects. The hold survives IPC completion, Resume, context restart and SC changes.

method.name: ReleaseExecutionHold
method.brief: Release an exact execution hold without inventing a wake.
method.description: Exact one-word request without extra caps containing the acquisition generation. A mismatch rejects before effects. Success has zero reply words and only reevaluates the target's current scheduling eligibility.
